title: Going deeper: Two choices that are both real
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Offer real choices, preparation and participation without handing over the adult responsibility.
pressureLine: Do you want to do it or not?
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
practice: choose between two workable ways to begin
principle: Use bounded choices that offer agency without false options.
nextSentence: The required task remains. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can choose between two workable ways to begin.
keyLearning: Use bounded choices that offer agency without false options.
